raw.cause: camera_handle() wedged in pause() (camera-hang fault, after frame 5) and never calls MsgReply(), so display's main thread, which calls MsgSend() to camera inline in its draw loop, sits REPLY-blocked forever and never reaches nav or logger again. No trace events were supplied, so this rests on the checker's finding (display thread 1 REPLY-blocked on camera, 0 messages completed) and the source. Adding a TimerTimeout would not help: the name_attach() channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, and the wedged camera never handles the unblock pulse.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend to camera in display's main loop (run_display), with MsgReply missing in camera (camera_handle)
raw.fix_summary: Take the camera MsgSend off display's draw path. Always run camera_reader in its own thread and have the loop read last_frame under frame_lock, showing "camera stale" when frame_age > 3. This is the COCKPIT_FIXED=1 path; make it unconditional. Then display keeps talking to nav and logger even if camera hangs or dies, and the reader thread is the only thing that blocks.

finding: camera stopped answering before the trace started and took display down with it
